parts.text:
Assess this contract for legal risk against our guidelines and generate the PDF report.

SAMPLE SERVICES AGREEMENT
1. Limitation of Liability: Provider liability is unlimited; no consequential damages waiver.
2. Indemnification: Broad uncapped indemnity for breach and ordinary negligence.
3. Intellectual Property: All Provider background IP assigned to Customer as work-for-hire.
4. Termination: Auto-renewal with 15-day notice; termination for convenience without fees; no cure period.
5. Payment: Net 75; unilateral price increases without notice.
6. Scope: Acceptance by sole satisfaction; 24-hour deemed acceptance.
7. SLA: Uncapped liquidated damages; immediate termination for any SLA miss.
8. Data Privacy: Personal data processed; no DPA; uncapped breach liability.
Overall contract risk is HIGH. A PDF risk report was generated covering Liability, Termination, Intellectual Property, and Operational & Business findings.
